rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" bh_autotools_dev_update
autoreconf -vi
export SHELL="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/sh" export PKG_CONFIG="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config"
export GUILE_LIBS="`${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config --libs guile-2.2`" export GUILE_CFLAGS="`${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config --cflags guile-2.2`"
# HACK: fix hard-coded pkg-config call in configure script. sed -i 's/`pkg-config/`$PKG_CONFIG/g' configure # HACK: fix incompatible mktemp usage sed -i 's/--suffix=.tdir//g' $(grep 'mktemp --suffix=.tdir' * -r | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u)
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-silent-rules \ --enable-timeout=78 \ --with-libxml2-libs="`${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config --libs libxml-2.0`" \ --with-libxml2-cflags="`${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config --cflags libxml-2.0`" \ --disable-nls \ --disable-rpath \ --with-packager="Bolt"
rules.install:
export SHELL="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/sh"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make top_srcdir="`pwd`" top_builddir="`pwd`" \ DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
